notablePrerequisites:
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.
